Fresh verification after explicit close-event synchronization; assertions and budgets remain intact.

securityAssessment: The independent stopped promise settles the application read when a transport/body reader ignores abort; native AbortController cancels compliant fetch and JSON streams. One monotonic budget spans headers and body.

Monotonic guards before JSON parsing and before result acceptance reject expired data even if timeout callback delivery is delayed. Superseded requests abort and settle without replacing current loading/error/ready state.

Finally clears only its own cancellation handle and deadline. Late fulfillment/rejection cannot create stale UI or unhandled promise rejection, and explicit retry gets a fresh controller and deadline.

Native test server binds ephemeral 127.0.0.1 inside the existing private network unit and serves only fixed GET /webapp and synthetic GET /api/history. Browser continuation additionally requires exact local origin, GET and one of those two paths; every other request aborts. No host/application/customer endpoint is permitted.

Native server cleanup awaits every tracked socket and server closure under a fixed limit, while supervisor cleanup independently reaps the entire unit. Test dependency addition is Node built-in http only.

Deployment remains one exact-hash HTML replacement with retained fsynced preimage and atomic rollback, inactive/failed autopilot/MainPID-zero guard and unchanged service identities; no service/database writer expansion.
limitations: Deadline tests use controlled monotonic/browser clocks; genuine native I/O cancellation is proven, but ten seconds of real elapsed network time is not claimed.
A suspended or blocked JavaScript event loop can delay visible timeout handling. Once execution resumes, expired results are rejected; this is not a hard real-time guarantee.
Application timers/cancel ownership/outer promises are bounded; arbitrary third-party promises that ignore abort cannot be forced to release their internal resources. Native tested streams do close.
This bounded diff review does not certify the entire existing application, complete malformed-row/action-URL schema validation, or close E4/earlier gates.

No real customer API/data, support message, money, signing, credentials, production or 064A action was performed by this reviewer. Real Telegram/iOS/WebKit, human comprehension and screen-reader announcements remain unverified.
Predeployment review; actual rollout/runtime verification remains primary-agent responsibility.
